metadata.title: ReadyYet, repair and service tracking for your customers
metadata.description: Let your customers follow their repair or order online, without calling the shop and without creating an account.

hero.label: / Tracking for shops
hero.title: Your customers know when it's ready
hero.lede: Dropped off, in progress, ready: they follow their item online, with no call to the shop and no account to create.
hero.artLabel: A phone showing the tracking of an item left at a shop

steps.title: Three steps, no phone calls
steps.intro: You log the item at the counter, your customer follows it online and comes back when it's ready. No app to install, no account to create.

step1.title: You log the item
step1.text: At the counter, in seconds: the customer, the item, the expected date. They get their tracking link by email or QR code.

step2.title: Your customer follows along
step2.text: Every step you mark shows up on their tracking page. They know where their item is without calling you.

step3.title: They come back when it's ready
step3.text: The moment you set the Ticket to Ready, they get an email. They come to collect it, no wasted trip.

tracking.title: Tracking page
tracking.text: Every item gets its own page with its steps and expected date. A link or a QR code is all it takes, no account, no app.

emails.title: Automatic emails
emails.text: Your customer hears from you when the item is logged and when it's ready. You don't write a thing.

workflow.title: Your trade's steps
workflow.text: Shoe repair, dry cleaning, electronics: each trade starts from its own steps. On Pro, you pick them and set their order.

promise.label: / Why ReadyYet
promise.statement: Every “is it ready yet?” call is an interruption for you and a wait for your customer. ReadyYet answers before they even ask.
promise.note: Nothing for your customers to install, nothing for your team to learn. You create your first Ticket in minutes, and the customer gets their link straight away.

intro.text: Every feature for 14 days, no card needed. After that, one subscription per shop, monthly or yearly, cancelled at the end of the period.

essentiel.name: Essentiel
essentiel.per: per month per shop, or €290 a year
essentiel.includes: Tracking page and automatic emails, 2 team members, your trade's default steps.
essentiel.idealFor: A shop with a small team that wants customers to stop calling.

pro.name: Pro
pro.per: per month per shop, or €490 a year
pro.includes: Everything in Essentiel, plus an unlimited team, your own steps, private feedback and Google review requests.
pro.idealFor: Workshops with their own way of working that want more reviews.

app.q: Do my customers need to install an app?
app.a: No. They get a link by email, or scan the QR code you hand them, and follow their item in their browser. No account, no app.

notified.q: How does my customer hear about it?
notified.a: By email: when the item is logged, when the expected date moves back and when it's ready. They can also open their tracking page whenever they like.

sms.a: No. Tracking works by email and QR code, which costs nothing extra, for you or your customers.

start.q: How long does it take to get started?
start.a: A few minutes. You create your shop, your trade's steps are already set up, and you log your first Ticket straight away.

afterTrial.q: What happens after the free trial?
afterTrial.a: You pick Essentiel or Pro for each shop. Without a subscription your data stays, but you can't create new Tickets.

shops.a: Yes. Each shop has its own subscription, team and steps, and you switch between them from the same account.
